text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I'd like to proceed. Can I
count on
you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet! That's an okey-dokey, delishy-fishy
from me!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I've heard you use that expression
before, but
what does "okey-dokey,
delishy-fishy" actually
mean?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I assume the first part means "okay," but
what
does "delishy-fishy "refer to?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? I guess delicious seafood... right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Does it mean you... know your seafood?
And if
so, how does that connect to
"okay"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, fish are like, super tasty? And
when you eat
top-tier food, the vibe
you're giving improves,
and that brings
all the party people to you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if you eat something
incredibly
delicious, you're more open
and receptive to
things. Hence you're
more likely to give an
emphatic "okay."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, slay! Your take is god-tier!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Still, there was so much
layered
nuance to that term. You're
quite learned, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you're making me blush! Anytime
you want
me to drop my wisdom, you
know where to find
me!
